name: Arqsheth
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Archon's Protection
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages the archon's ally and both are within 15 feet of the archon

Effect The ally gains resistance 15 to all damage against the triggering damage, and the archon can make a Strike against the enemy. This Strike doesn't count toward the archon's multiple attack penalty, and their multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Effect: Archon's Protection

defensiveAbilities.name: Armament of the Archons
defensiveAbilities.description:
A single creature can wield an adjacent willing arqsheth as a free action as long as it has two free hands. Once wielded by another creature, an arqsheth can't be wielded by a different creature until the start of the arqsheth's next turn. While wielded as a weapon, an arqsheth counts as a martial ranged weapon that deals 2d10 Fire Damage damage; is in the laser group; has a range increment of 40 feet; and has the analog, holy, and tracking +2 traits. Strikes made with this weapon deal an extra 1d10 Spirit Damage damage. They don't require ammunition and have no Bulk, as they support their own weight.

Effect: Armament of the Archons

offensiveAbilities.name: Archon's Pursuit
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The arqsheth saw another creature teleport within the last round

Effect The arqsheth casts Translocate, which is heightened to 5th rank and causes the arqsheth to arrive in an unoccupied space they choose within 30 feet of the creature they're pursuing. If the creature is too far away, the arqsheth arrives as close as possible.

offensiveAbilities.name: Righteous Cannon
offensiveAbilities.description: An arqsheth can be the target of spells that can target a ranged weapon, such as Supercharge Weapon, while wielded by another creature.

cantrips.name: Message
cantrips.description:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

lv2spells.name: Sure Strike (At Will)
lv2spells.duration: until the end of your turn
lv2spells.description:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

Spell Effect: Sure Strike

lv2spells.name: Revealing Light
lv2spells.description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is Dazzled. If the creature was Invisible, it becomes Concealed instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

lv4spells.name: Translocate (At Will)
lv4spells.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv5spells.name: Truespeech (Constant)
lv5spells.description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
